claims.text: NRO's published leadership as of August 2026 is Acting Director William B. Adkins; the agency describes its workforce as 31% NRO cadre, 34% detailed government personnel and 35% military.
NRO lists William B. Adkins as Acting Director and describes its workforce as 31% NRO cadre, 34% detailed government personnel and 35% military.

edges.label: House Appropriations Defense subcommittee staff overseeing NRO/NSA/NGA
edges.note: Before becoming PDDNRO he 'served on the professional staff of the House Appropriations Committee, Subcommittee on Defense, where he led the subcommittee's oversight and legislative responsibility for the NRO, U.S. Space Force, U.S. Space Command, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency, National Security Agency, and U.S. Cyber Command' - the panel that writes the classified defense appropriations annex.
